policies.retention_basis: User-controlled; no mandatory floor outside audit record
policies.notes: Source file deleted immediately on DELETE /api/jobs/{id}. Audit tree records deletion event hash (write_deletion() — STS-123). Source file must not be exported or replicated outside STS_DATA_DIR.

Transcript removed on DELETE /api/jobs/{id}. Export artifacts (TXT/SRT/VTT/JSON) delivered to operator and outside system control after export. Operator governs exported copies per organizational records policy.

policies.deletion_trigger: STS_AUDIT_MIN_RETENTION_DAYS floor must be reached; requires explicit IT action; no user self-service delete
policies.enforcement: audit_store.retention_floor_reached(job_id, min_days=STS_AUDIT_MIN_RETENTION_DAYS) checked before any tree deletion. Application never self-deletes audit tree.
policies.notes: Retention floor is non-waivable per AUDIT_SINGLE_PURPOSE_PRINCIPLE.md. IT controls STS_AUDIT_MIN_RETENTION_DAYS (default 365) and STS_AUDIT_MAX_RETENTION_DAYS (default 2555 / 7 years). Job deletion appends a deletion record to the tree but does not remove the tree. Encryption requirement: DPAPI or IT-managed AES-256-GCM (see ADR-007).
Metadata deleted with job. Not separately retained.

policies.gap: Event log retention policy not implemented. ADR required before QG-03 closes. Encryption for event log also not implemented — gap linked to R-20.

pilot_note: For a real corporate pilot, DPO signatory must be replaced by a named individual with organizational legal authority over records and privacy policy. Retention policy is not binding until DPO approval is recorded.
